title: Describing changes over time / Kugena ibyashyitsemo mu gihe
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugena ibyashyitsemo birashishwa na 'get', 'become' n' 'turn' byoroshye kenshi biterwa nka 'gufata', 'gutegura' cyangwa 'gushyira' mu ikinyarwanda. Ahubwo, mu gaciri ntibirashishwa amaso n'umwuka 'to be' hamwe n'imigambi kugena ibyashyitsemo; ahubwo, birashishwa ibyo mwuka bihariwe. Nanone, mu gaciri harimo ubwoko bw'imperfect tense ('have changed') n'ubwoko bw'past simple ('changed'), ibintu ntibifite ubwoko buhaniranye n'ubwoko bw'imperfect tense n'ubwoko bw'past simple mu ikinyarwanda. Abanyarwanda bashobora kugena 'ndi umenye nka kera' bakoresha 'I am more tired' ahubwo 'I have gotten more tired'.
rule: Kugena ibyashyitsemo mu gaciri: 1) Kora 'get' + igambi (cyangwa umusaruro) kugena ibyashyitsemo bishyashye cyangwa bishyashye mu gihe: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Kora 'become' + igambi/ina cyangwa izina kugena ibyashyitsemo bishyashye cyangwa bishyashye mu buryo bufite ubwoko: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Kora 'turn' + ikomani cyangwa igambi kugena ibyashyitsemo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Kugena ibyashyitsemo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'amagara cyangwa ubwoko bw'ubwoba, ntidushobora kugena 'grow' (gutura) n' 'fall' (kwimura) mu magambo yagombanye: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) 'Used to' birashishwa kugena ibintu byishyize byari byo mu burengera: 'I used to live here'. 6) 'No longer' n' 'still' birashishwa kugena ubwoko bw'ibintu: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Imperfect tense birashishwa kugena ibyashyitsemo byihariye mu burengera: 'The town has changed a lot'. Ntukoreshe 'to be' + igambi nka mu ikinyarwanda: 'ndi umenye nka kera' ntibiterwa 'I am tired' ahubwo 'I have gotten tired'.

common_error.wrong: I am more tired now than before.
common_error.correct: I have gotten more tired now.
common_error.correct_alt: I have become more tired now.
common_error.explanation: Ibikorwa biterwa kubera ko mu ikinyarwanda harimo 'ndi umenye nka kera' kugena ibyashyitsemo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko. Ariko mu gaciri, 'I am tired' birashishwa kugena ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko, ntibyashyitsemo. Kugena ko byashyitswe, koresha imperfect tense n' 'get' cyangwa 'become' (cyangwa 'have gotten' / 'have become'). Ntidushobora kugena 'I am more tired' kugena ibyashyitsemo, ahubwo kugena ubwoko bw'ibintu. Ntukoreshe uburasirazuba n'ubushishozanawe, ahubwo niba wishyura ubwoko bw'ibintu cyangwa ibyashyitsemo.

examples.original: He became famous after the video.

examples.note: Kugena ibyashyitsemo by'ubwoko bw'ubwoko (umenye, umukire), 'become' ni byihariwe. Mu ikinyarwanda, harimo 'gutegura'.

examples.original: The situation became complicated.

examples.note: Kugena ubwoko bw'ubwoko bw'ubwoko cyangwa ubwoko bw'ubwoko, koresha 'become' + izina bitandukanye n'ijambo.

levels.translation: Kugena ibyashyitsemo n' 'used to' n' 'no longer'

examples.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈlɔːŋɡər iːt miːt/
examples.note: Mu ikinyarwanda, harimo 'ntinda', mu gaciri 'no longer' ni byihariwe kurusha 'don't... anymore'.

examples.note: Mu gaciri, 'didn't use to' birashishwa (bitandukanye n' '-d' mu mwisho wa 'use'). Kumbure ubushishozanawe: /juːst/.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Gutangaza no kugera ibanga
bridge: Mu gaciri, tubona 'debe de ser' cyangwa 'puede que sea' kugutanga ibanga. Mu Icyongereza, tubona amabwiriza 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' + infinitive. Ikintu gikwiye ni uko 'must' bivuga gutanga ibanga ry'ukuri (byiza) na 'can't' bivuga gutanga ibanga ry'omuburo; 'might', 'may' na 'could' bivuga ubushakashatsi.
rule: Kugera ibanga mu Icyongereza, tubona amabwiriza ayo ashizeho kurema umubare w'umwanya w'icyo gihe: 'must' (gutanga ibanga ry'ukuri uko ikintu ni ukuri), 'can't' (gutanga ibanga ry'ukuri uko ikintu si ukuri), 'might', 'may', 'could' (ubushakashatsi, bidahagije). Kugera ibanga kuri cyo kimye kishize, tubona 'must have + past participle', 'can't have + past participle', 'might have + past participle', adi. Uburyo ni: umuntu + modal + umubare w'umwanya w'icyo gihe (mu mwezi) cyangwa modal + have + past participle (mu mwezi kishize). Ishusho: mu gaciri, 'debe de ser' na 'no puede ser' ni ibintu bimwe, ariko mu Icyongereza, nta 'must not be' itavugwa kugera ibanga ry'ububiko; tubona 'can't be'.

concept_examples.text: He must be tired after the long trip.
concept_examples.translation: Yemwe agomba kumara byinshi nyuma y'urugendo rwakaze.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst biː ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə lɔːŋ trɪp/

concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtən ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: It could rain later, so take an umbrella.

common_error.wrong: He must not be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct: He can't be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct_alt: He must be out because the lights are off.
common_error.explanation: Ibaba ryagenewe kubera mu gaciri tubona 'no debe estar' kuvuga gutanga ibanga ry'ububiko, ariko mu Icyongereza, 'must not' bivuga kwihangana ('no debe' = nta ububiko). Kugera ibanga uko ikintu si byinshi cyangwa si ukuri, tubona 'can't' (cyangwa 'couldn't' kugira ngo byihutirwe). 'Must be out' ni byiza kubera uko bivuga ibintu bimwe: gutanga ibanga uko nta ari mu rugo.

levels.label: Deductions with must and can't
levels.translation: Gutanga ibanga na must na can't

examples.original: You're a journalist. You must meet a lot of people.

examples.translation: Uri umunyamakuru. Wagombye kumenya abantu benshi.

examples.original: That can't be the right answer.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt kænt biː ðə raɪt ˈænsər/
examples.translation: Ibi ntibishobora kuba ni icorabuhanga gihuye.

examples.original: He must have a lot of money because he drives a Ferrari.

levels.label: Possibility with might, may, and could
levels.translation: Ubushakashatsi na might, may na could

examples.original: She might be at the gym right now.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt biː æt ðə dʒɪm raɪt naʊ/
examples.translation: Ashobora kuba ari mu gishushanyo ubu.
examples.note: 'Might' bivuga ubushakashatsi bidasanzwe kurushaho 'must'. Mu gaciri, 'puede que'.

examples.original: They may arrive late because of the traffic.

examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə best ˈrestərɒnt ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Iyi shobora kuba ni idukikije ryiza kurushaho mu mugi.
examples.note: 'Could' nayo bivuga ubushakashatsi na tubona cyane mu majambere.

levels.label: Deductions about the past
levels.translation: Gutanga ibanga kuri cyo kimye kishize

examples.original: He must have studied a lot for the exam.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ˈstʌdid ə lɒt fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Agomba kuba yigishije byinshi kuri ikirango.
examples.note: Tubona 'must have + past participle' kugera ibanga kuri cyo kimye kishize. Mu gaciri, 'debe de haber'.

examples.original: She can't have seen us because she didn't wave.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt hæv siːn ʌs bɪˈkɒz ʃiː dɪdnt weɪv/
examples.translation: Nta n'ubwo yabonye kubera ko atashyize.
examples.note: 'Can't have + past participle' bivuga gutanga ibanga ry'ububiko kuri cyo kimye kishize. Mu gaciri, 'no puede haber'.

examples.original: They might have missed the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv mɪst ðə bʌs/
examples.note: 'Might have + past participle' bivuga ubushakashatsi kuri cyo kimye kishize. Mu gaciri, 'puede que hayan'.

examples.original: The roads are wet. It must have rained.
examples.phonetic: /ðə roʊdz ɑːr wet. ɪt mʌst hæv reɪnd/
examples.note: Ibintu byamenyekanye (ibyuma byaraze) bidufasha kugera ibanga ry'ukuri kuri cyo kimye kishize.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Kugena ubwoba n'ibyo bishoboka
bridge: Mu gaciri, ubugambo bw'ikinyarwanda bworoshye gukoresha amagambo ya kondisionali na subjuntivo kugena ibyo bishoboka n'ubwoba (nk'uko bivugwa, 'si nari nakirimo, nari ngaya'). Mu Icyongereza, uburyo bwo kugena buri mbere: bikoresha ubu akanye (cyangwa ubu akanye bwishuze) mu gice cy'if, na 'would' + igisubizo mu gice kiherekeza. Ibishushanyo by'ingirakamaro ni guhindura 'si nari ngenda' kuva 'if I would have', ariko mu Icyongereza, gice cy'if ntikigira 'would'. Nanone, kugena ibintu bishoboka mu bishamye, bikoresha ubu akanye bwishuze ('had + igikorwa') ahandi y'uburyo bw'ikondisionali.
rule: Mu Icyongereza B1, kugena ibyo bishoboka mu munda cyangwa mu muryango (ikindwi cya kabiri), bikoresha 'if + ubu akanye' (cyangwa 'if + ubu akanye bukomeye') mu gice cy'ikondisionali, na 'would + urutonde' mu gice kiherekeza. Imisubizo: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (Si nari nashoboye kuba n'igihe, nari ngaya). Niba 'were' bikoreshwa mu buri wese mu 'if I were' (naho 'was' ni ikinyabiziga mu Icyongereza isanzwe). Kugena ubwoba ku bishamye (ikindwi cya gatatu), bikoresha 'if + ubu akanye bwishuze' (had + igikorwa) na 'would have + igikorwa' mu kiherekeza: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (Si nari narasomye, nari nkwishimye). Nanone, ubworoshye kugena ubwoba: 'I wish I had studied.' (Nshaka nari narasomye). Remera ko gice cy'if ntikigira 'would' cyangwa 'will'. Mu bindi bisubizo, 'were' ni ikinyabiziga: 'If he were here...'.

common_error.correct: If I had time, I would go to the party.

Kugira ngo udahire ibishushanyo, remera ko 'if' biganjirwa n'ubu akanye (kugena ibyo bishoboka mu munda/muryango) cyangwa ubu akanye bwishuze (kugena ibyo bishoboka mu bishamye), na 'would' biganjirwa mu gice kingi.

title: Discussing Advantages and Disadvantages / Kuganira ibyiza n’ibyabi
bridge: Mu gaciro, dushtura amashusho ‘ventajas’ na ‘desventajas’ nk’amatsiko, ariko mu Icyongereza bikoreshwa cyane kubw’ishusho ‘advantages’ na ‘disadvantages’ hamwe n’imvugo nk’ ‘have’ cyangwa ‘there are’. Nanone, mu Icyongereza bikoreshwa ‘pros and cons’ mu mwishehe, ibyo ntibifite icyo kibaza n’icyo mu gaciro. Kandi, ushyireheje kugira ubwoba kugira ngo ushyiremu ‘por un lado’ nk’uko bishiriyeho ‘for one side’ – igisubizo cy’ukuri ni ‘on the one hand’.
rule:
Kugana ibyiza n’ibyabi mu Icyongereza ku murongo wa B1, shimira ako karuseso:
1. 'One advantage (of) is that...' / 'One disadvantage (of) is that...' – hanyuma y’umugani w’igitsina na mvugo.
2. 'The advantages of + ishito/gerundio are...' kugira ngo ubyemere.
3. 'On the one hand... on the other hand...' kugira ngo ubyemere ibintu bibiri.
4. 'However' cyangwa 'Nevertheless' kugira ngo ushyireho ikintu gikomeye nyuma y’kwiganira ibintu byiza.
5. 'Pros and cons' ni inyuganfu eza nk’ishusho ry’amatsiko: 'Let's weigh the pros and cons.'
Kumbuka ko mu Icyongereza ntibikoreshwa ‘of’ nyuma y’ ‘advantage’ ubwo nta n’ishusho rishura: 'It has many advantages' (nti ‘advantages of’).

concept_examples.translation: Umwanya wo kuba mu mugi mukuru ni ko hafi n’ubushakashatsi bw’umwanya wo gukorera.

title: Narrating a story / Kugura inkuru cyangwa igishushanyo
bridge: Mu gihugu, kugura inkuru mu ikinya dusaba neza imperfetwo n'ubundi pretérito, kandi ubwoko bwabo ni bwihariye. Mu liyongereza, imbaraga ni ibyerekana, ariko n'ibindi bifuza gutangwa: 'past simple' bisaba ibyakozwe, kandi 'past continuous' bisaba ibyakozwe mu ikinya. Ibibazo byinshi ni kugura 'estaba + gerundio' mu gihugu kugeza mu liyongereza, ariko mu liyongereza byinshi bisaba 'used to' cyangwa 'would' kugura ibyakozwe mu ikinya, ibintu ntibifite ubwoko bwihariye mu gihugu. Nanone gutangira: mu liyongereza, 'past perfect' (had + participio) ni byinshi kurusha 'pluscuamperfecto' mu gihugu kugura ubushake mu kugura inkuru.
rule:
Kugura inkuru mu liyongereza mu mpanuro w'ibiri mu B1, wigeze kuva na mpanuro kuri bwa mbere ubu:
1. **Past Simple** (kuri: umuntu + igisubizo mu ikinya, ntibiboneka: 'walked'; ntibyemeza: 'didn't + igisubizo'; ibibazo: 'Did + umuntu + igisubizo?'). Bisaba ibyakozwe n'ibyakozwe mu ikinya, mu mbonera.
2. **Past Continuous** (was/were + igisubizo -ing). Ibisobanura ibyakozwe mu ikinya, byinshi bikorwa n'ibyakozwe (past simple).
3. **Past Perfect** (had + participio mu ikinya). Ibisobanura ibyakozwe kurushwa n'ibyakozwe mu ikinya. Ntibisabwa byinshi nk'ubwoko bwihariye mu gihugu, ariko ni byo kugura ubushake.
4. **'Used to'** (umuntu + used to + igisubizo kigenzura) kugura ibyakozwe cyangwa ibyakozwe mu ikinya bitagira ubwoko bwihariye.
5. **'Would'** kugura ibyakozwe mu ikinya (mu kugura inkuru z'ubwenge cyangwa z'ubwenge).
Ibyakozwe: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', etc. Ibisobanura inkuru.
Ibikorwa: igisubizo ntibikorwa (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Kugura ntibyemeza n'ibibazo tubofashe 'did' n'igisubizo kigenzura.
Kuri B1, rema 'past perfect continuous' (byinshi).

title: Arguing a point of view / Kugura ibitekerezo
bridge: Mu gihugu, kugura ibitekerezo tubyara gutumira amagambo nk'ukuti 'mu bitekerezo bange' cyangwa 'ntekereza ko', kandi ubwenge buri kensi bukazwa n'umwimerere. Mu Icyongereza, umuntu ni wa buri kensi kandi ubwenge buri kensi bukazwa n'amagambo nk'ukuti 'Ntekereza ko...' cyangwa 'Mu bitekerezo bange...'. Nanone, mu Icyongereza bishimwa gutumira 'should' kugura ibitekerezo cyangwa kugura amahame, mu gihugu tubyara gutumira 'debería' cyangwa 'tendría que'. Nigute umwete kugura 'ntekereza ko' nk'ukuti 'I think that' (ni byiza) ariko ushobora kugura umuntu: 'Ntekereza ko' = 'I think that' (nti 'Think that'). Ubwenge bw'ibibi ni ukugura 'I am agree' aho ubwenge ni ukugura 'I agree', kubera mu gihugu 'estar de acuerdo' bishimwa gutumira 'estar' ariko mu Icyongereza 'agree' ni umwimerere wa kensi.
rule:
Kugura ibitekerezo mu Icyongereza ku murongo wa B1, tumira ubwenge bw'ibikorwa:

1. **Kugura ibitekerezo:** 'Ntekereza ko...', 'Ntekereza ko...', 'Mu bitekerezo bange...', 'Ku buryo bwanje...'. Inyu: 'Ntekereza ko gutungura ni cyiza.'
2. **Kugura ibiranga:** 'kubera', 'kuko', 'nk'uko'. Inyu: 'Ntekereza ko turakeneye gutungura amazi kubera ko ni cyo kintu cyiza mu buzima.'
3. **Kugura ibitekerezo cyangwa amahame:** 'should' + umwimerere wa kensi (nti 'to'). Inyu: 'Abantu bashinge gutumira ubwato bw'umutwe bw'umutwe.'
4. **Kugura ibitekerezo / kugura ibitekerezo:** 'Ndahemuka', 'Ntahemuka', 'Ndahemuka nawe', 'Ntahemuka'. Inyu: 'Ndahemuka n'ibitekerezo byawe.' (Nta: 'I am agree').
5. **Kugura ibitekerezo:** 'Ariko', 'ariko', 'ku buryo bwingine'. Inyu: 'Bamwe bantu bitekereza bityo, ariko ntahemuka.'

Nigute umwete ko mu Icyongereza umuntu ni wa buri kensi, n'ubwenge buri kensi bukazwa n'umwimerere: 'Ndahemuka' nti 'Dahemuka'. Nanone, 'think' na 'believe' bashobora kugura 'that' (nti byiza) cyangwa kugura umwimerere wa kensi. Ku murongo wa B1, ni byiza gutumira 'that' kugira ngo ubone neza. Amagambo y'ubwenge yashimwa n'umwimerere 'be' (Ndahemuka neza), ariko amagambo y'ubitekerezo atagira 'be'.

title: Talking about your job and career / Kuganira ku kuri wako n’ubucuruzi bwawe
bridge: Mu gihingirishya, dusaba dushtura amagambo ‘work as’ (I work as a doctor) cyangwa ‘be’ (I am a doctor). Nanone, gihingirishya igaragaza neza ubwoko ‘work’ (igikorwa gishya) n’ubwoko ‘job’ (ubucuruzi bw’inyuma), mu gihugu cyacu dushtura ‘trabajo’ kuri buri rimwe. Kandi, kugira ubwoba n’ubushake bw’imyaka: mu gihugu cyacu dushtura ‘sujeto’, ariko mu gihingirishya byagombye kugira.
rule:
Kugana ku kuri wako n’ubucuruzi bwawe mu gihingirishya ku murongo wa B1, ushtura:
- Present simple kugana ku kuri wawe ubu: 'I work as a teacher' (ndi mucoorewusi) cyangwa 'I am a teacher'.
- 'Work in' + igice cyangwa aho (I work in a hospital), 'work for' + igishushanyo (I work for Microsoft), 'work with' + abantu cyangwa ibintu (I work with children).
- Kugana ku bucuruzi bwawe, ushtura 'career' (ubucuruzi) n’ubwoko ‘job’ (ubucuruzi bw’inyuma). Cyerekezo: 'I'm looking for a new job' (ndagira ubucuruzi bw’inyuma), 'She has a successful career' (yagize ubucuruzi bwiza).
- Kugana ku ibyo ushaka cyangwa ibyo ushaka kugenzura, ushtura 'would like to' + infinitivo (I'd like to change careers) cyangwa 'planning to' (I'm planning to look for a new job).
- Kumbuye amagambo yo kuri ‘always’, ‘usually’, ‘often’, ‘sometimes’, ‘never’ kugana ku ibintu ufite kuri wawe.

title: Describing processes / Kugamburira ibikorwa
bridge: Mu igifaransa, harakuye kugamburira ibikorwa bikoresheje urupapuro rw'umuntu wese (nk'uko bivugwa, 'se calienta el agua') cyangwa umubare w'iminsi. Mu Icyongereza, ni ikintu gihuye kugamburira ibikorwa bikoresheje urupapuro rw'umuntu wese (nk'uko bivugwa, 'the water is heated') na imfunguzo z'ububiko nk'uko bivugwa, 'first', 'then', 'next', 'after that', 'finally'. Igishushanyo kiri mu kuri ya kuwa mu igifaransa dusabwa kugira ubwoko, ariko mu Icyongereza urupapuro rw'umuntu wese rwishimiye cyangwa rukoresheje urupapuro rw'umuntu wese rw'ubwoko bw'umuntu wese. Ubwo rero, ububiko bw'amagambo mu Icyongereza ni bishushanyije: mbere n'ubwoko, hanyuma n'urupapuro, na imfunguzo z'ubwoko zikurikiwe n'urupapuro.
rule: Kugamburira ibikorwa mu Icyongereza ku murongo B1, bikoresheje neza umubare w'iminsi (kuri ibintu by'ubwoko) na urupapuro rw'umuntu wese (urupapuro rw'umuntu wese: am/is/are + urupapuro rw'umuntu wese) ubwo ubushake buhariwe kuri ikibazo. Ububiko bw'ubwoko ni: Mbere, [ikintu] is/are + urupapuro rw'umuntu wese. Hanyuma bikurikiwe n'imfunguzo z'ububiko: first, then, next, after that, later, finally. Ubwo rero, bikoresheje neza urupapuro rw'umuntu wese (nk'uko bivugwa mu miyugo) cyangwa 'you' urupapuro rw'umuntu wese. Urupapuro rw'umuntu wese rukomeye: ubwoko + urupapuro 'to be' rukomeye + urupapuro rw'umuntu wese. Nk'uko bivugwa: 'The coffee is ground.' Ntibishoboye kugira ubwoko bw'imfunguzo z'ubwoko (always, usually, often) zikurikiwe n'urupapuro rw'umuntu wese ariko zikurikiwe 'be' (nk'uko bivugwa, 'The water is always heated first'). Mu Icyongereza, hatarukana n'igifaransa, ntibikoresheje 'se' kuri urupapuro rw'umuntu wese; bikoresheje urupapuro rw'umuntu wese n'urupapuro 'be' cyangwa urupapuro rw'umuntu wese rw'ubwoko bw'umuntu wese.

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / Kugena ubwoba na kuri kane
bridge: Mu gaciri, dusaba ubushobozi bw'umwihariko cyangwa ibyakozwe nk'ubwokozi 'ntibari' na 'ntibari' kugena ubwoba, ariko mu Icyongereza nta mugenzi w'umwihariko; aho kugena ubwoba, dusaba amabwiriza yo kwiga nk'ubwokozi 'might' na 'could' cyangwa ibyakozwe nk'ubwokozi 'maybe' na 'perhaps'. Ibyo ushaka kumenya: 'must' ntibyo bishobora kuba 'debe' kugena ubwoba, ahubwo bishobora kugena ubwoba bw'ubushobozi (debe de).
rule: Kugena ubwoba mu Icyongereza, dusaba: 1) Ibyakozwe: 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'probably', 'definitely' (ku mwishura cyangwa nyuma y'umuntu). 2) Amabwiriza yo kwiga: 'may', 'might', 'could' kugena ubwoba (may/might ariho kuri kane; could ariho kuri kane mu by'ubushobozi). 3) 'Must' kugena ubwoba bw'ubushobozi: 'She must be at home'. 4) Uburenganzira 'be likely to' cyangwa 'be unlikely to' kugena ubwoba. Mu by'ubushobozi, dusaba 'might not' cyangwa 'may not' (nta 'could not' kugena ubwoba, kubera 'couldn't' bishobora kugena ubushobozi bw'ubushobozi).

title: Making formal requests / Gutanga ibikorwa bigaragara ne guhandisha amashuri y’ubugeni
bridge: Mu igifaransa, harakaze tubona tubikoraho ubwoko bw’imperatif (‘Pourriez-vous...?’, ‘Serait-il possible...?’) kugutanga ibikorwa bigaragara. Mu Icyongereza, ubwoko bw’imperatif ntabwo bwigaragara cyane, kandi harakaze tubikoraho ‘Would you mind...?’ hamwe n’amajwi yo kugenda (-ing), ubwoko ntibwigwa n’ubundi mu igifaransa. Menya ko ushyigikira ‘Would you care...?’ kandi ukoresheje ‘Would you mind...?’ kubera ko bishobora gutuma umuntu ashushanywa.
rule:
Kugutanga ibikorwa bigaragara mu Icyongereza (umubare w’ibikorwa B1), koresha ubwoko bw’amajwi aba:
1. **Would you + amajwi y’ibikorwa...?** – 'Would you send me the report?' (Wishobora kungirwa igitabo cy’ibikorwa?). Ni by’ubwoba kandi bigaragara.
2. **Could you + amajwi y’ibikorwa...?** – 'Could you help me with this?' (Wishobora kundekera mu by’iyi?). Ni nk’ubwoko bw’ ‘Would’, ariko bigaragara kuruta.
3. **Would you mind + amajwi yo kugenda (-ing)?** – 'Would you mind closing the window?' (Wishobora kuguma ububiko?). Ubwoko bw’amajwi buya bigaragara kandi bushyigikirwa mu ibikorwa byo kuguma. Ushobora kushimisha ‘No, not at all’ niba ntushobora kuguma.
4. **I would like to + amajwi y’ibikorwa** – 'I would like to request a refund.' (Nshaka kugutanga ikibazo cy’ububiko). Kugutanga ikibazo cyawe.
5. **Ibikorwa bigaragara by’ibikorwa ‘Would it be possible to...?'** – 'Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?' (Wishobora kugutanga ikibazo cy’ububiko?). Bigaragara cyane, bikoreshwa mu imeri.
Menya: mu Icyongereza, ‘please’ bishyigikirwa mu mwisho y’ijambo cyangwa nyuma y’umuntu mu ibikorwa, si mu mbere nk’mu igifaransa. Ntibishobora kugutanga ‘Please, could you help me?’ ariko ‘Could you help me, please?’.

translations.rw: Gutanga ibikorwa bigaragara ne guhandisha amashuri y’ubugeni
